title: "DG Shipping / DGMA" removed from QB1_G#q40 - the authority is named in full, with the former name kept only as a historical gloss
candidate_claim: Founder: delete DG Shipping from QB1_G#q40 - it is not called that any more. "Formerly DG Shipping" is acceptable; the slash pair is not.
rationale: CORR-CSM-INDIA-AUTHORITY-20260823 introduced the string 'DG Shipping / DGMA' twice on this card, once in the authority-order bullet and once as the reg-box code. That construction presents a retired name and its successor as live alternatives, which implies the old name is still current. It also regressed a convention the repository had already settled: the Entry 6 follow-up audit converted 191 references across 65 files from 'DG Shipping' to 'DGMA', and the corpus expands the name consistently as 'Directorate General of Maritime Administration' in 31 places. The card now names the authority in full on first mention, keeps 'formerly DG Shipping' as a parenthetical gloss so a candidate who has read older circulars can connect the two, and uses 'DGMA' as the short form thereafter including the reg-box code.
note: Scope was deliberately held to q40. QB1_G carries about a dozen other 'DG Shipping' strings, and they were checked and left alone because they are document titles - 'DG Shipping Engineering Circular 02 of 2024', 'DG Shipping MS Notice 08 of 2022' and similar. A circular's title is its identity at time of issue; renaming it would make it uncitable and an examiner would not recognise the renamed form. That distinction was put to the Founder and confirmed. Ten further candidate-facing files outside QB1_G still contain 'DG Shipping' strings of the same two kinds; no sweep was run here, and any such sweep would need its own record because it would have to separate live-authority references from document titles file by file. The naming change is the whole of this correction: no technical claim, citation, interval or authority-hierarchy statement was touched, and the CSM/boiler substance of the two preceding corrections is unchanged.

QB1_G.html governed version 1.3 -> 1.4; one corrections_applied row added and one recently_updated row prepended. Canonical totals unchanged at 721 questions across 86 files.
